review_note: SUBWAY ROUND 4 (Lucas's review, 2026-09-17). Three rooms only; every other station is PASSED and must not be touched. The specs are already fixed — generate from them as they stand, commit, seam, render. ochre_hall: the stair was drawn ACROSS the wrap join again (two half-stairs, one at each edge), so its element now states EXACTLY ONE stair and one shaft, out on the floor a third of the way in from the left edge and none at either extreme edge. Its canvas dust-sheeting mover is GONE (the clip invented crazy fabric along the tracks); the mover is now a galvanised bucket in the immediate foreground catching a slow drip, rings spreading — Lucas asked for something subtle, so do NOT make it vigorous and do NOT add a second mover. ochre_verdigris: same one-stair clause; its water clip was GOOD, keep the seep mover and its phrase exactly. alum_lampblack: the train's road and the tunnel read at right angles and the left side doubled its tracks, so the berth element now states ONE straight pair of rails in line with ONE tunnel mouth, no siding/crossover/points, and the duplicate end elements are deleted; its smoke fell INTO the fire, so the phrase now says the coil rises upward only, gently.
